# Breaking changes to the planner's or the gateway's API (and, until 2026-11-12, the assistant's) made on purpose,
# which ci.yml's api-compat job lets through (oasdiff --err-ignore).
# One line each, dated, with the method and path and oasdiff's own words
# for the change, as its failure printed them, and why no released app
# is hurt. Kept after the merge, as the record of what was broken when.
# See docs/CI.md, "API compatibility".
